message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to fetch live data from external services like VirusTotal. However, you can obtain the WHOIS history yourself by running a `curl` command similar to this:

```bash
curl -X GET \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/adobe.com/whois_history \
     -H "x-apikey: adobe_key123"
```

Make sure your environment has network connectivity and replace `"adobe_key123"` with your valid API key. If you need help formatting the request or interpreting the response, feel free to ask!
